blocks.html:
This method retrieves the preview of an order based on its last associated change. It sends a request to the
[Get Order Preview](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#orders\_getordersidpreview) API route.

children.name: created_at
children.description: The date the order was created.

children.name: updated_at
children.description: The date the order was updated.

children.name: original_item_total
children.description: The sum of all line items' original totals before discounts, including taxes.

children.name: original_item_subtotal
children.description: The sum of all line items' original subtotals before discounts, excluding taxes.

children.name: original_item_tax_total
children.description: The sum of all line items' original tax totals before discounts.

children.name: item_total
children.description: The sum of all line items' totals after discounts, including taxes.

children.name: item_subtotal
children.description: The sum of all line items' subtotals before discounts, excluding taxes.

children.name: item_tax_total
children.description: The sum of all line items' tax totals after discounts.

children.name: item_discount_total
children.description: The sum of all discounts applied to line items, including the tax portion of discounts.

children.name: original_total
children.description: The order's total before discounts, including taxes. Calculated as the sum of `original_item_total` and `original_shipping_total`.

children.name: original_subtotal
children.description: The order's subtotal before discounts, excluding taxes. Calculated as the sum of `original_item_subtotal` and `original_shipping_subtotal`.

children.name: original_tax_total
children.description: The order's tax total before discounts. Calculated as the sum of `original_item_tax_total` and `original_shipping_tax_total`.

children.name: total
children.description: The order's final total after discounts and credit lines, including taxes.

children.name: subtotal
children.description: The order's subtotal before discounts, excluding taxes. Calculated as the sum of `item_subtotal` and `shipping_subtotal`.

children.name: tax_total
children.description: The order's tax total after discounts. Calculated as the sum of `item_tax_total` and `shipping_tax_total`.

children.name: discount_total
children.description: The total amount of discounts applied to the order, including the tax portion of discounts.

children.name: discount_tax_total
children.description: The total amount of discounts applied to the order's tax. Represents the tax portion of discounts.

children.name: gift_card_total
children.description: The total gift card amount.

children.name: gift_card_tax_total
children.description: The tax total applied on the order's gift card amount.

children.name: shipping_total
children.description: The sum of all shipping methods' totals after discounts, including taxes.

children.name: shipping_subtotal
children.description: The sum of all shipping methods' subtotals before discounts, excluding taxes.

children.name: shipping_tax_total
children.description: The sum of all shipping methods' tax totals after discounts.

children.name: shipping_discount_total
children.description: The sum of all discounts applied to shipping methods, including the tax portion of discounts.

children.name: original_shipping_total
children.description: The sum of all shipping methods' original totals before discounts, including taxes.

children.name: original_shipping_subtotal
children.description: The sum of all shipping methods' original subtotals before discounts, excluding taxes.

children.name: original_shipping_tax_total
children.description: The sum of all shipping methods' original tax totals before discounts.

children.name: credit_line_total
children.description: The total amount of credit lines applied to the order, including taxes. Subtracted from the final total.
